name: Willowbrook Farm
description: A cozy farming simulator where you plant crops, raise animals and befriend the villagers of a sleepy countryside town at your own relaxed pace.

name: Turnip Hollow
description: Run a relaxing farm together with up to four friends. Share the chores, grow vegetables, decorate the barn and enjoy a calm online co-op farming adventure.

name: Sunpatch Valley
description: Rebuild an abandoned valley farm, expand the town and grow your harvest in this peaceful farming and town-building game with gentle seasons.

name: Little Orchard Days
description: A peaceful orchard keeping game: prune trees, make jam, sell fruit at the market and relax with a soothing soundtrack and no time pressure.

name: Pasture & Pie
description: Farm fresh ingredients and bake pies for the whole village. Couch co-op for two players makes this cooking and farming sim a warm game to play with a friend.

name: Beehive Buddies
description: Keep a colony of bees, collect honey and decorate your meadow with friends in a casual, relaxing co-op game that anyone can pick up in minutes.

name: Paper Lantern Garden
description: A zen gardening puzzle game. Arrange stones, plants and lanterns to create calm gardens, with soft music and no fail states.

name: Quiet Harbor
description: A chill fishing game set in a misty harbor town. Cast your line, collect rare fish and chat with locals while the day slowly passes.

name: Moss & Mist
description: Hike through foggy forests and mountain trails in a peaceful exploration game about slowing down and enjoying the scenery.

name: Bookshop Nights
description: Open a tiny bookshop after dark. Recommend stories to quirky customers, arrange shelves and drink tea in this cozy management game.

name: Cloud Cartographer
description: Sail between floating islands and draw maps of the sky. A relaxing exploration game with a gentle story and painterly visuals.

name: Campfire Tales Co-op
description: Gather around the campfire with friends and tell cooperative stories in this relaxing party game full of laughter, drawing and silly prompts.

name: Sandcastle Architects
description: A free relaxing sandbox where you build giant sandcastles, share creations with friends and enjoy a calm beach atmosphere.

name: Cafe Cosmos
description: Run a cozy space cafe, brew galactic coffee and decorate your station. A charming management game that is easy to relax with.

name: Tiny Colony
description: Guide a small community of settlers in a relaxing colony builder where you set priorities, gather resources and watch your village grow.

name: Ashfall Squad
description: Team up with up to three friends in a fast cooperative shooter and survive waves of zombies in ruined cities with upgradeable weapons.

name: Neon Breach
description: A fast-paced cyberpunk first person shooter with a story campaign, hacking abilities and neon-drenched arenas.

name: Rustline Raiders
description: Four-player cooperative third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Loot, upgrade your vehicle and defend your camp together.

name: Bunker Zero
description: Hold the bunker with a friend in a cooperative horde shooter for two to four players, with tight gunplay and scary night waves.

name: Orbital Strike Arena
description: A free-to-play competitive team shooter with short matches, class abilities and ranked seasons set on orbital stations.

name: Pixel Gunners
description: A retro top-down shooter where two players can team up in couch co-op, blasting robots through colorful pixel art levels.

name: Iron Frontier Tactics
description: A turn-based tactics game about leading a small squad through a frontier war, with deep positioning and permanent consequences.

name: Kingdom of Embers
description: A grand strategy game of diplomacy and conquest in a medieval fantasy world, with deep economy and shifting alliances.

name: Hexa Wars
description: A quick hex-based board strategy game for one or two players. Easy to learn, hard to master and perfect for short sessions.

name: Ember Saga
description: A sprawling fantasy RPG with a branching story, party-based combat and hundreds of quests across a hand-painted continent.

name: Crypt of Echoes
description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where every run is different. Choose a hero, collect relics and fight through haunted crypts.

name: Nova Drifters
description: A space RPG about a crew of drifters trading, fighting and exploring a vast galaxy full of strange factions and ancient ruins.

name: Redline Rally
description: A fast arcade rally racing game with dozens of cars, dirt tracks and online time-attack challenges.

name: Pocket Kicks
description: Arcade soccer for local multiplayer with chaotic power-ups, short matches and a mode for up to four players on one screen.

name: Wave Rider Surf
description: A laid-back surfing game with calm waves, tricks and sunset sessions. Easy controls make it a relaxing sports game.

name: Gloomy Glow
description: An atmospheric puzzle platformer about a tiny light spirit exploring dark caves, with clever light-and-shadow puzzles.

name: Block Garden
description: A minimalist block-sliding puzzle game with hundreds of handcrafted levels and a soothing soundtrack.

name: Echo Chamber Puzzles
description: Solve sound-based puzzles in a series of echoing rooms. A short, clever puzzle adventure for patient players.

name: Hollow Corridors
description: A psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. Hide, listen and survive as something follows you through the dark.

name: The Last Signal
description: A survival horror game on a remote arctic station, where you must keep the radio alive while an unknown presence hunts you.

name: Skyward Isles
description: A colorful adventure across floating islands. Glide, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the sunken sky kingdom.

name: Case of the Missing Clockmaker
description: A mystery adventure in a snowy clock town. Interrogate suspects, collect clues and piece together the clockmaker's last night.

name: Rail Baron Tycoon
description: Build a railway empire, manage routes and outsmart rival companies in this classic transport tycoon.

name: Cityline Planner
description: Plan and manage a modern city with detailed zoning, traffic and budgets in this deep city builder.

name: Dungeon Buddies
description: A four-player co-op dungeon brawler. Pick a class, smash monsters and share loot with friends in colorful procedural dungeons.

name: Kitchen Chaos Crew
description: Chaotic cooperative cooking for up to four players. Chop, fry and deliver orders in kitchens that keep changing around you.

name: Brawl Street Legends
description: A 2D arcade fighting game with a roster of street legends, combo systems and fast local or online versus matches.

name: Stellar Idle Miner
description: A free idle game about mining asteroids. Upgrade your drills, hire robots and watch your space empire grow while you relax.
